notes.title: Release Announcement! Beta Testing Ended!
notes.content:
🍉 Release Announcement! 🎮

Thank You, Beta Testers!

Good luck on your watermelon journey! 🍉

notes.title: A big thanks to all of our beta testers!
notes.content:
Thanks to all of our awesome beta testers!

Thank you so much for being a part of the Watermelon Challenge beta test! Your invaluable feedback has played a crucial role in shaping our game, and we're thrilled to share the progress we've made based on your suggestions.


Mouse Controls: We heard your requests, and now you can effortlessly move and drop fruits using your mouse. This can also be disabled in the options menu if you're feeling old-school. We hope this enhances your gaming experience!
Graphical Updates: Our menus have received a small facelift, with added options on the main title screen. We believe these changes will contribute to a more visually appealing and user-friendly game!
Pop Update: You wanted more pop when combining fruits, and we've made adjustments to bring an extra dose of excitement to those moments. Get ready for an even more satisfying fruit merge!
Multiplayer Improvements: Playing head-to-head with friends is now smoother than ever. We appreciate your feedback on this, and we're continuing to tweak and enhance the multiplayer experience. Plus, we've introduced a new, intense soundtrack specifically for multiplayer sessions!


We genuinely couldn't have achieved this level of polish without your dedicated testing. Your enthusiasm and insights have been instrumental in making our first game a success. But, this is just the beginning – there's more in store! Keep the feedback flowing, and aim for that fabled watermelon!

Once again, thank you for being an essential part of the Watermelon Challenge journey! <3

[center]Floofy Feather Studios[/center]
